notes: Fixes Market weapon cards that showed both a malformed concatenated legacy rich-description block and the new FEHA weapon summary.
The Market patch now recognizes unclassed legacy description containers, including melee cards whose HTML collapsed into strings like 'FEHA // MELEE WEAPON...DAMAGE3d6...'.
When a correct FEHA summary was previously appended below the action buttons, the patch moves that summary into the original description slot and removes the duplicate placement.
The cleanup stays observer-free, so it does not reintroduce the Shop freeze fixed in 0.11.76.
No prices, stock, weapon balance, DEX rules, reload cadence, armor, cyberware, grenades, or Quickhacks changed.
